comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district signs. Coordinates are real-world lat/lon, projected to world space via road.project() at load time. Trigger radius in compressed-world metres (scale 0.3). needs_owner_review:true = confirmed by map research only — owner's lived knowledge is authoritative over any entry here.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: Narrow sand spit — sea on both sides, coconut trees, Gun Boat Beach on the left

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Roundabout at the end of the Palisadoes where the airport road meets the main road

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Industrial area and Rockfort Mineral Bath

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's modern business and hotel district

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Major uptown commercial hub — the clock tower dates to 1813

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Capital of Saint Catherine Parish — first Spanish capital of Jamaica (Villa de la Vega, 1534)

communities.name: Sligoville
communities.note: First free village in the Caribbean after Emancipation (August 1838)

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Gateway to the gorge — Rio Cobre and Flat Bridge just ahead

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Busy market town in St. Catherine — immortalised in the folk song Linstead Market

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Cool mountain crossroads between St. Catherine and St. Ann — once a famous spa town

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Famous strip of roadside cook shops — jerk chicken, roast yam and festival

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Iconic bamboo-arched road — once a riverbed, now a living cathedral of green

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Tourism hub on Jamaica's north coast — journey's end at Dunn's River Falls
